description: This file is a header file (`pager.h`) for a C project, declaring functions and structures related to managing a pager in a terminal, such as setting up, checking usage, and handling terminal properties.

methods.name: git_pager
methods.description: Returns the pager command associated with a repository, possibly considering terminal properties.

methods.name: setup_pager
methods.description: Initializes pager settings for a given repository.

methods.name: wait_for_pager
methods.description: Waits for the pager process to complete.

methods.name: pager_in_use
methods.description: Checks if a pager is currently in use.

methods.name: term_columns
methods.description: Returns the number of columns of the terminal.

methods.name: term_clear_line
methods.description: Clears the current line in the terminal.

methods.name: decimal_width
methods.description: Calculates the number of digits needed to represent a given number.

methods.name: check_pager_config
methods.description: Checks the configuration for the pager command.

methods.name: prepare_pager_args
methods.description: Prepares the arguments for the child_process to run the pager.
